Air Traffic Control Systems Are Outdated. What’s Being Done to Prevent Another Outage?

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Saturday blamed the previous day’s nationwide ground stop on the replacement of copper wires at a “remote” Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) facility. Installing new fiber optic lines led to critical communication breakdowns, he said. About 7,500 flights were delayed and over 9,000 were canceled on Friday, according to FlightAware .
